note: Ground truth for the classifier, labelled by hand from a real fetch on 2026-08-30. These are the 22 articles that passed the prefilter. Stage 2 is scored against them: a run that disagrees on division is a precision failure, which is the bar that matters — an article filed under the wrong county is a false statement about a real place. A second pass (2026-09-04) labelled the 145 candidates from a later fetch; those carry "by": "claude" and are excluded from scoring, because measuring a model against labels a model wrote proves nothing. Only the hand-labelled entries are ground truth.
rules: division: where the OFFENCE happened. null when the article reports no recorded offence, names no Irish location, or the location cannot be resolved.
town: only a place the article itself names, and only when it locates the offence. A court's town is not the offence's town.
group: CJQ06 group. null when no specific recorded offence is reported — a fatal road accident with no alleged offence has a division but no group.
by: who labelled it. "hand" entries are ground truth and score model runs; "claude" entries place articles on the map but are never scored against.
